^You are on a quest to slay (.+)!$
can be found in the vicinity of (.+?) which\s*$

Script.name: snd
Script.script:
--[[ Search & Destroy — mob/area data layer Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
The MUSHclient Search_and_Destroy.xml is a 360KB plugin: quest/campaign/gquest target tracking, its own runto, a target miniwindow and a self-updater. Most of the movement half of that is Mudlet's speedwalker's job, so what's ported here is the part nothing else replaces — the mob/area database and the lookups over it.
That database is also what SolaoBot's 'solbot mob <kw>' reads, which is why it lands before the rest of S&D.
Not ported (deliberately): the runto/target automation and the plugin self-updater. See PORTING.md. ]]
solao = solao or {} solao.snd = solao.snd or {}
local SD = solao.snd local U = solao.util
local ok, handle = pcall(db.create, db, "solaosnd", { mobs = { mob = "", room = "", roomid = 0, zone = "", seen_count = 0, kill_count = 0, _index = { "mob", "zone" }, _unique = { { "mob", "roomid" } }, }, area = { name = "", key = "", minlvl = 0, maxlvl = 0, lock = 0, startRoom = 0, noquest = "", vidblain = "", userKey = "", _index = { "key" }, _unique = { { "key" } }, }, keywords = { area_name = "", mob_name = "", keyword = "", _index = { "mob_name" }, _unique = { { "area_name", "mob_name" } }, }, })
SD.dbh = ok and handle or nil SD.dberr = (not ok) and tostring(handle) or nil
-- lazily resolved, same reason as Loot Tracker's: a nil here reads to every -- consumer as "S&D isn't loaded" and never recovers SD.t = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, k) local d = SD.dbh or (db and db.solaosnd) return d and d[k] or nil end, })
local T = SD.t
--- -- capture (off by default; the trigger is disabled until 'snd scan on') ---
-- strip the transient status flags Aardwolf prefixes -- "(flying) a casanova" local function strip_flags(m) local s = tostring(m or "") while true do local n = s:gsub("^%s*%b()%s*", "", 1) if n == s then break end s = n end return U.trim(s) end
function SD.on_scan(mob) mob = strip_flags(mob) if mob == "" then return end local roomid, room, zone = U.room() if not roomid then return end local where = db:AND(db:eq(T.mobs.mob, mob), db:eq(T.mobs.roomid, roomid)) local found = db:fetch(T.mobs, where) if found and found[1] then db:update(T.mobs, { seen_count = (found[1].seen_count or 0) + 1, room = room or "", zone = zone or "" }, where) else db:add(T.mobs, { mob = mob, room = room or "", roomid = roomid, zone = zone or "", seen_count = 1, kill_count = 0 }) end end
--- -- lookups ---
local function keyword_for(mob) local r = db:fetch(T.keywords, db:eq(T.keywords.mob_name, mob)) return r and r[1] and r[1].keyword or nil end
function SD.where(term) term = U.trim(term) if term == "" then U.warn("Usage: mobwhere <keyword>"); return end
local rows = db:fetch(T.mobs, db:like(T.mobs.mob, "%" .. term .. "%")) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No mob matching '" .. term .. "' in the S&D data.") return end
-- merge per mob name so one line covers every room it's been seen in local agg, order = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local nm = strip_flags(r.mob) local a = agg[nm] if not a then a = { name = nm, zone = r.zone or "", room = r.room or "", ids = {}, seen = {}, cnt = 0 } agg[nm] = a order[#order + 1] = nm end if r.roomid and r.roomid ~= 0 and not a.seen[r.roomid] then a.seen[r.roomid] = true a.ids[#a.ids + 1] = r.roomid end a.cnt = a.cnt + (r.seen_count or 0) end table.sort(order, function(x, y) return agg[x].cnt > agg[y].cnt end)
U.note(#order .. " mob(s) matching '" .. term .. "':") for i, nm in ipairs(order) do if i > 20 then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>... " .. (#order - 20) .. " more<r>") break end local a = agg[nm] local kw = keyword_for(nm) U.out("\n <#7aa2f7>" .. a.name .. "<r>" .. (kw and (" <#8a93a8>[" .. kw .. "]<r>") or "")) U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>" .. (a.zone ~= "" and a.zone or "?") .. " - " .. (a.room ~= "" and a.room or "?") .. "<r>") local ids = {} for j, id in ipairs(a.ids) do if j > 8 then ids[#ids + 1] = "..."; break end ids[#ids + 1] = U.rid(id) end if #ids > 0 then U.out(" <#8a93a8>rooms: " .. table.concat(ids, ",") .. "<r>") -- clickable: hand the first room to the Mudlet speedwalker U.outLink(" <#3ad07a>[go]<r>", "solao.snd.walkto(" .. U.rid(a.ids[1]) .. ")", "Speedwalk to room " .. U.rid(a.ids[1]), true) end end echo("\n") end
function SD.walkto(roomid) if not roomExists(roomid) then U.warn("Room " .. U.rid(roomid) .. " isn't in the Mudlet map. Run 'aardmap import yes' first.") return end local here = getPlayerRoom() if not here then U.warn("Mudlet doesn't know where you are yet - move a room and try again.") return end if getPath(here, roomid) then U.ok("Walking to " .. U.rid(roomid) .. " (" .. #speedWalkDir .. " steps).") doSpeedWalk() else U.warn("No path from " .. U.rid(here) .. " to " .. U.rid(roomid) .. ".") end end
local function show_area(term) term = U.trim(term):lower() local rows = db:fetch(T.area) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No area data. Run 'solao migrate' to bring it over from MUSHclient.") return end local hits = {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if term == "" or (r.name .. " " .. r.key):lower():find(term, 1, true) then hits[#hits + 1] = r end end table.sort(hits, function(a, b) return (a.minlvl or 0) < (b.minlvl or 0) end) U.note(#hits .. " area(s):") for i, r in ipairs(hits) do if i > 40 then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>... " .. (#hits - 40) .. " more<r>") break end U.out(string.format("\n <#7aa2f7>%-32s<r> <#8a93a8>%-14s L%d-%d%s<r>", r.name, r.key, r.minlvl or 0, r.maxlvl or 0, (r.startRoom or 0) > 0 and (" start " .. U.rid(r.startRoom)) or "")) end echo("\n") end
--- -- commands ---
local scan_on = false
function SD.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" then SD.paint() SD.panel:toggle()
elseif verb == "status" then local m = db:fetch(T.mobs) or {} local a = db:fetch(T.area) or {} local k = db:fetch(T.keywords) or {} U.help("Search & Destroy data", { { "mobs", tostring(#m) }, { "areas", tostring(#a) }, { "keywords", tostring(#k) }, { "scanning", scan_on and "on" or "off" }, })
elseif verb == "cp" or verb == "campaign" then SD.kind = "campaign"; SD.refresh("campaign"); SD.panel:show()
elseif verb == "quest" or verb == "q" then SD.kind = "quest"; SD.refresh("quest"); SD.panel:show()
elseif verb == "gq" or verb == "gquest" then SD.kind = "gquest"; SD.refresh("gquest"); SD.panel:show()
elseif verb == "go" then local n = tonumber(U.trim(rest)) if not n then U.warn("Usage: snd go <number>") else SD.goto_target(SD.kind, n) end
elseif verb == "next" then local i = SD.next_target(SD.kind) if not i then U.note("Nothing left in " .. SD.kind .. ".") else SD.goto_target(SD.kind, i) end
elseif verb == "dock" or verb == "embed" or verb == "hide" or verb == "show" then solao.panel.cmd("snd " .. verb)
elseif verb == "mob" or verb == "where" then SD.where(rest)
elseif verb == "area" or verb == "areas" then show_area(rest)
elseif verb == "scan" then local v = U.trim(rest):lower() if v == "on" or v == "off" then scan_on = (v == "on") enableTrigger("scan mob line") if not scan_on then disableTrigger("scan mob line") end U.ok("S&D: room scanning " .. v .. ".") else U.warn("Usage: snd scan on|off") end
else U.help("Search & Destroy data", { { "snd", "show/hide the target panel" }, { "snd cp | quest | gq", "read your targets and show them" }, { "snd go <n>", "walk to target n" }, { "snd next", "walk to the first one still owed" }, { "snd status", "row counts" }, { "snd mob <keyword>", "where a mob has been seen (clickable [go])" }, { "mobwhere <kw>", "same thing, shorter" }, { "snd area [text]", "area list with level ranges and start rooms" }, { "snd scan on|off", "record mobs from room descriptions as you go" }, { "" }, { "Click a target in the panel to walk there. The commands are" }, { "here for muscle memory; nobody has to learn them." }, }) end end
solao.register("snd", "mob/area database from Search & Destroy", SD.cmd)

Script.name: snd/targets
Script.script:
--[[ Search & Destroy — quest / campaign / gquest targets Sean Stoves, 2026-08-01
The MUD tells you what to kill; this remembers it and looks up where it lives in the mob table the data layer already holds. That's the whole job.
Output formats below are the MUD's own, captured live 2026-08-01. An earlier version of this file guessed them from another plugin's trigger patterns and got them wrong, which is why nothing ever parsed:
The targets for this campaign are: * a bartering customer (Fellchantry) * Yeti Hunting Party (Helegear Sea) You have 6 days, 23 hours and 59 minutes left to finish this campaign.
You are on a quest to slay Eldred the Wise! Eldred the Wise can be found in the vicinity of Training Room which is in the general area of The Witches of Omen Tor.
The campaign rows are just "* name (area)", which is far too generic to leave a trigger sitting on all session. So it arms on the header and releases on the time-remaining line, with a timer in case that never lands. ]]
solao = solao or {} solao.snd = solao.snd or {}
local SD = solao.snd local U = solao.util
-- kind -> ordered list of { name, area, qty, killed } SD.targets = SD.targets or { quest = {}, campaign = {}, gquest = {} } SD.kind = SD.kind or "campaign"
local function list(kind) return SD.targets[kind] or {} end
local function add(kind, name, area, qty) name = U.trim(name or "") if name == "" then return end local t = list(kind) for _, e in ipairs(t) do if e.name:lower() == name:lower() then return e end end t[#t + 1] = { name = name, area = U.trim(area or ""), qty = tonumber(qty) or 1, killed = false } return t[#t] end
function SD.clear(kind) SD.targets[kind] = {} if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
--- -- where does it live -- -- The mob table is keyed on the name the MUD prints, but quest text and room -- text don't always agree on articles, so fall back to a keyword match before -- giving up. ---
function SD.locate(name) local T = SD.t if not (T and T.mobs) then return nil end local n = U.trim(name or ""):lower() if n == "" then return nil end
local rows = T.mobs and db:fetch(T.mobs, db:like("mob", n)) or {} if #rows == 0 then local bare = n:gsub("^an? ", ""):gsub("^the ", "") rows = db:fetch(T.mobs, db:like("mob", "%" .. bare .. "%")) end if #rows == 0 then return nil end
table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return (a.seen_count or 0) > (b.seen_count or 0) end) return rows[1] end
-- walk there using Mudlet's own mapper; we are not writing a second speedwalker function SD.goto_target(kind, i) local e = list(kind)[i] if not e then U.warn("No target " .. tostring(i) .. " in " .. kind .. "."); return end
local row = SD.locate(e.name) if not row or not row.roomid or row.roomid == 0 then U.warn("Don't know where '" .. e.name .. "' lives." .. (e.area ~= "" and (" Area: " .. e.area) or "")) return end
e.room, e.roomid = row.room, row.roomid U.ok("-> " .. e.name .. " " .. (row.room or "?") .. " " .. U.rid(row.roomid)) local ok, err = pcall(gotoRoom, row.roomid) if not ok then U.warn("Mapper wouldn't walk there: " .. tostring(err)) end if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
-- first one still owed function SD.next_target(kind) for i, e in ipairs(list(kind)) do if not e.killed then return i end end end
--- -- parsing ---
local cp_trig, cp_timer
local function cp_stop() if cp_trig then killTrigger(cp_trig); cp_trig = nil end if cp_timer then killTimer(cp_timer); cp_timer = nil end if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
SD.cp_stop = cp_stop
function SD.on_cp_header() SD.targets.campaign = {} SD.kind = "campaign" cp_stop() cp_trig = tempRegexTrigger("^\\* (.+) \\((.+)\\)\\s*$", function() add("campaign", matches[2], matches[3], 1) end) -- released by the "You have N days ... to finish" line; this is the backstop cp_timer = tempTimer(10, cp_stop) end
function SD.on_quest_target(name) SD.targets.quest = {} add("quest", name, "", 1) SD.kind = "quest" if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
-- "<mob> can be found in the vicinity of <room> which" function SD.on_quest_room(room) local e = list("quest")[1] if e then e.room = U.trim(room or "") end if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
-- "is in the general area of <area>." function SD.on_quest_area(area) local e = list("quest")[1] if e then e.area = U.trim(area or "") end if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
function SD.on_gq_target(qty, name) add("gquest", name, "", qty) SD.kind = "gquest" if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
function SD.on_cp_done() SD.targets.campaign = {} U.ok("Campaign complete.") if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
function SD.on_quest_done() SD.targets.quest = {} if SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
-- Ticks a target off. NOT currently wired to a trigger: the MUD's per-target -- campaign kill line hasn't been captured live yet, and guessing the pattern -- would tick off the wrong things. Until it is, progress updates when you re-run -- the check, which is why the panel says so rather than showing a stale count. function SD.on_kill(name) name = U.trim(name or ""):lower() if name == "" then return end local hit = false for _, t in pairs(SD.targets) do for _, e in ipairs(t) do if not e.killed and (e.name:lower() == name or e.name:lower():find(name, 1, true) or name:find(e.name:lower(), 1, true)) then e.killed = true hit = true end end end if hit and SD.paint then SD.paint() end end
--- -- counts, for the tab labels ---
function SD.counts(kind) local t, done = list(kind), 0 for _, e in ipairs(t) do if e.killed then done = done + 1 end end return done, #t end

Script.name: snd/ui
Script.script:
--[[ Search & Destroy — panel Sean Stoves, 2026-08-01 The MUSHclient plugin drives everything through about twenty-five terse aliases: xq, cp ch, gq i, ht, qw, nx, nx-, go 3, xrt, qk, aha, xg ref. They all made sense to whoever wrote them and none of them are guessable. So: three tabs and a list you click. Click a target and it walks you there. That's the whole interface. Every command still exists underneath for muscle memory, but nobody has to learn them to use this. ]] solao = solao or {} solao.snd = solao.snd or {} local SD = solao.snd local U = solao.util local TAB_H, ROW_H, PAD = 24, 22, 4 local COL = { bg = "#0d1117", tab = "#1b2540", tabon = "#274060", row = "#141b2d", hover = "#274060", text = "#c8d0dc", dim = "#8a93a8", done = "#3ad07a", accent = "#e94560", border = "#3a4a6b", } local KINDS = { "quest", "campaign", "gquest" } local LABEL = { quest = "Quest", campaign = "Campaign", gquest = "GQuest" } local panel = solao.panel.new({ name = "snd", title = "Search & Destroy", x = "10px", y = "560px", width = 380, height = 300, consoleless = true, }) SD.panel = panel local tabs, rows, foot = {}, {}, nil local function style(bg, border) return string.format( "background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 3px;", bg, border or COL.border) end local function num(v) return tonumber((tostring(v or "0"):gsub("px", ""))) or 0 end local function width() local c = panel.container local w = c and num(c.get_width and c:get_width() or c.width) or 360 return w < 60 and 360 or w end --- -- clicks --- function SD.on_tab(kind) SD.kind = kind SD.paint() end function SD.on_row(i) SD.goto_target(SD.kind, i) end function SD.on_refresh() SD.refresh(SD.kind) end --- -- paint --- local function tab_label(i, kind) local name = "solao_snd_tab" .. i .. "_" .. (panel.gen or 1) if not tabs[i] then tabs[i] = Geyser.Label:new({ name = name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = TAB_H }, panel.container) tabs[i]:setClickCallback("solao.snd.on_tab", kind) end return tabs[i] end local function row_label(i) local name = "solao_snd_row" .. i .. "_" .. (panel.gen or 1) if not rows[i] then rows[i] = Geyser.Label:new({ name = name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = ROW_H - 2 }, panel.container) rows[i]:setClickCallback("solao.snd.on_row", i) end return rows[i] end function SD.paint() if not panel.container then return end local w = width() local tw = math.floor((w - PAD * 4) / #KINDS) for i, kind in ipairs(KINDS) do local l = tab_label(i, kind) local done, total = SD.counts(kind) local on = (SD.kind == kind) l:move(PAD + (i - 1) * (tw + PAD), PAD) l:resize(tw, TAB_H) l:setStyleSheet(style(on and COL.tabon or COL.tab, on and COL.accent or COL.border)) l:echo(string.format( "
%s" .. " %d/%d
", on and COL.text or COL.dim, LABEL[kind], COL.dim, done, total)) l:show() end local t = SD.targets[SD.kind] or {} local top = PAD * 2 + TAB_H local avail = math.max(1, math.floor((num(panel.container and (panel.container.get_height and panel.container:get_height() or panel.container.height)) - top - ROW_H - PAD) / ROW_H)) local shown = 0 for i = 1, math.min(#t, avail) do local e = t[i] shown = shown + 1 local l = row_label(i) l:move(PAD, top + (i - 1) * ROW_H) l:resize(w - PAD * 2, ROW_H - 2) l:setStyleSheet(style(COL.row)) local mark = e.killed and "✔" or (e.qty > 1 and ("x" .. e.qty) or "•") local col = e.killed and COL.done or COL.text local where = (e.room and e.room ~= "" and e.room .. " ") or "" where = where .. (e.area or "") l:echo(string.format( " %s %s" .. "  %s%s", col, mark, e.name, COL.dim, where, e.corpse and " (corpse out)" or "")) l:show() end for i = shown + 1, #rows do rows[i]:hide() end if not foot then foot = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "solao_snd_foot" .. (panel.gen or 1), x = PAD, y = "-" .. (ROW_H + PAD) .. "px", width = 10, height = ROW_H - 2, }, panel.container) foot:setClickCallback("solao.snd.on_refresh") end foot:resize(w - PAD * 2, ROW_H - 2) foot:setStyleSheet(style(COL.tab)) if #t == 0 then foot:echo("
nothing tracked — click to read your " .. LABEL[SD.kind]:lower() .. "
") else foot:echo("
" .. #t .. " left" .. (#t > avail and (" • " .. (#t - avail) .. " below") or "") .. " • click to walk • click here to re-check
") end foot:show() end -- ask the MUD to tell us again function SD.refresh(kind) kind = kind or SD.kind if kind == "campaign" then send("campaign check", false) elseif kind == "quest" then send("quest info", false) else send("gquest info", false) end end U.killhandler(solao_snd_resize_handler) solao_snd_resize_handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysWindowResizeEvent", "solao.snd.paint")
